_comment: TEMPLATE — do NOT put real personal data here (this file is committed). Copy to an UNTRACKED file on the admin host (recommended /opt/macro/admin/analytics_exclusions.json — gitignored, survives deploys, read per request) and fill in real values. Optionally point ANALYTICS_EXCLUSIONS at a different path (e.g. /var/lib/macro-admin/…). See admin/analytics_first_party.py:_load_exclusions.

_keys.emails/locations/ips: OPERATOR SELF-EXCLUSION — any visitor matching a registered email, a location (ip_geo city/region/country match), or one of these exact IPs is hidden from every analytics surface, along with cookies linked by device fingerprint or routable IP. Loopback IPs are never used for linking.
_keys.bots: CRAWLER FILTER — crawlers/automation are hidden by default and shown separately via the 'show bots' toggle. Detection = bot user-agent OR datacenter-not-VPN IP OR known crawler network org OR one of bots.ips. ua_pattern/org_pattern EXTEND the baked-in defaults (Postgres regex, case-insensitive).
_keys.geo_overrides: DISPLAY RELABEL — force the shown city/region/country for any IP starting with ip_prefix (fixes IPs geolocated to the wrong place, e.g. an HK VPN read as Frankfurt).
